strings.眠れる律動が溢れ満ちる、休憩時HPを追加で<color=#27D327>30%回: A sleeping rhythm brims and overflows; restores an extra <color=#27D327>30% HP</color> when resting.
strings.内圧がせり上がる、戦闘開始時に攻撃力を<color=#ff701a>5%アップ<: Internal pressure rises; raises Attack <color=#ff701a>5%</color> at battle start.
strings.タツミヤ鉱が余っていますが、終了してよろしいですか？\n\n<size=30><:
You still have Tatsumiya Ore left. Are you sure you want to finish?

<size=30><color=#ff1c0b>All Tatsumiya Ore is collected and cannot be carried over to the next exploration</color></size>
strings.ピコピコピーン！！\n超高性能AIであるボクが改めてチューンナップの説明をします:
Ding-ding-ding!!
I, the super-high-performance AI, will explain Tune-Ups once again!
strings.チューンナップは以上になります！\nタツミヤ鉱を使い切ったら右下の完了ボタンで終:
That's everything for Tune-Ups!
Once you've used up your Tatsumiya Ore, press the Complete button at the bottom right!
strings.そんな時のアーティファクト！\n一種のお守りの様なものだと思って下さい！:
That's where Artifacts come in!
Think of them as a kind of charm!
strings.メイズ探索で行き詰ってしまった！\nタイプ装備もスキルも強化が行き詰った…:
You've hit a wall in Maze Exploration!
Your Type Equipment and skills are upgraded as far as they go...
strings.謎アイテムその２のアーティファクト！\nメイズ内だけで不思議と効果をもたらしてく:
Mystery item number two: the Artifact!
It mysteriously grants effects only inside the Maze,
and the principle behind it is shrouded in mystery...
strings.毎日の積み重ねになるので\n微量の上昇量だといっても大切です！:
It builds up day after day,
so even a tiny increase matters!
strings.こちらの採掘効率を上げる事によって\n普段の採掘機能で獲得できる各報酬量が上昇し:
Raising Mining Efficiency here increases
the amount of each reward you get from the regular Mining feature!
strings.パーツによって強化されるパラメータが違うので\nキャラクター達の伸ばしたいパラメ:
Each part boosts a different parameter,
so raise the parameters you want your characters to grow!
strings.タイプ装備を強化する事によって、\nそのタイプに属するキャラクター全員の能力が上:
Enhancing Type Equipment raises the abilities of
every character that belongs to that type!
strings.生徒のスキル強化に必要なアイテム。\\n能力を高めるための基礎訓練内容が記録され: An item needed to enhance students' skills.\nA tablet recording the basic training content needed to raise their abilities.
strings.デイリーのスキル強化アイテムは貴重なアイテムです！\n一日の購入回数上限もあるた:
The daily skill enhancement items are precious!
There is also a daily purchase limit, so trade for them every day♪
strings.タツミヤ鉱は基本全て生徒会の管理下におかれるため\n余すことなくタツミヤ鉱は使っ:
Tatsumiya Ore is basically all managed by the Student Council,
so please use every last bit of it♪
strings.今回のマスターの探索で獲得したタツミヤ鉱はこちらになります！: Here is the Tatsumiya Ore you obtained on this Master's exploration!
strings.ピコピコピーン！！\nはじめてのチューンナップ、超高性能AIであるボクが説明しま:
Ding-ding-ding!!
I, the super-high-performance AI, will explain your first Tune-Up!
strings.進行方向にボスメイズシフターが待ち受けている。討伐しないと先に進めなさそうだ…戦: A boss Maze Shifter awaits in the direction of travel. It looks like you can't proceed without defeating it... Battle is unavoidable.
strings.全身を巡る力場が覚醒を促す。探索中、全員のスキルレベルを<color=#ff70: A force field coursing through the whole body urges awakening. During exploration, all members' skill levels rise <color=#ff701a>1</color> (stackable).
strings.侵蝕波が敵陣を蝕む、戦闘開始時敵全体の攻撃力<color=#ff701a>10%: A wave of corrosion eats into the enemy formation; at battle start all enemies' Attack drops <color=#ff701a>10%</color>.
strings.進行方向にメイズシフターの痕跡が見つかった。警戒級メイズシフターの波長が検知され: A Maze Shifter trace was found in the direction of travel. The wavelength of a caution-class Maze Shifter has been detected...
strings.メイズ探索のスキップはクリアした事があるエリアのみです！\n道中でいろんな事が起:
Skipping Maze Exploration is only possible for areas you have cleared before!
All sorts of things happen along the way, so be careful in new areas, all right?
strings.集う刃が時を狙う、自身がAS3回毎に、次の攻撃の威力が<color=#ff701: Gathered blades bide their time; every 3 AS the user performs, the power of their next attack rises <color=#ff701a>50%</color> (PP cost: 1).
strings.戦場に生まれた光脈が、味方全員を癒やす。戦闘開始時に味方全員のHPを<color: A vein of light born on the battlefield heals everyone. At battle start, restores <color=#27D327>4% HP</color> to all allies.
strings.活性化した細胞が命を満たす。獲得時、最大HPが<color=#ff701a>+2: Activated cells fill the body with life. When obtained, Max HP <color=#ff701a>+20%</color>.
strings.<line-height=2.000em>それでは私はこれにて。引き続き、あなた:
<line-height=2.000em>I will take my leave here, then. I look forward to you continuing
to fulfill your role as an instructing commander.
strings.<line-height=2.000em>戦闘の指揮から探索ルートの選択まで、\:
<line-height=2.000em>From commanding battles to choosing exploration routes,
every single decision affects the whole team.
strings.<line-height=2.000em>それにその担当エリア内でも、どこまで進:
<line-height=2.000em>And even inside your assigned area, how far you can go ties directly to the team's――
especially to the skill of whoever commands it.
strings.<line-height=2.000em>といっても、担当エリアが決まっているの:
<line-height=2.000em>That said, the assigned areas are fixed, so it's not as if
you can dig as much as you like.
strings.<line-height=2.000em>掘れば掘るほど、生徒の皆さんはガッポガ:
<line-height=2.000em>The more you dig, the more the students rake in～!
The more you hand over to the academy, the bigger your rewards!
strings.<line-height=2.000em>みんな、ここからメイズ探索に行くんだよ:
<line-height=2.000em>Everyone heads into Maze Exploration from here, right...
to get Tatsumiya Ore.
strings.<line-height=2.000em>わかってるよ。俺、この学園のことまだほ:
<line-height=2.000em>I know. I still barely know anything about this academy,
so I'm looking around the place.
strings.<line-height=2.000em>生身ではメイズに入れませんよ。: <line-height=2.000em>You can't enter the Maze in the flesh, you know.
strings.<line-height=2.000em>こんなところで何をしているんですか、\:
<line-height=2.000em>What are you doing in a place like this,
<noparse>Dreamer</noparse>-san.
strings.<line-height=2.000em>そりゃそうですよ！ なんたって、ＭＧが: <line-height=2.000em>Of course it is! After all, an MG passes through here～!
strings.解放されているエリアの最奥に最初からチャレンジするのは\nとっても危険なのでエリ:
Challenging the deepest part of your unlocked areas from the start is
extremely dangerous, so please start from Area 1!
strings.<line-height=2.000em>メイズの出入り口――『ポータル』。\n:
<line-height=2.000em>The Maze entrance――the “Portal”.
Seeing it like this again, it's a huge place.
strings.とはいっても最初から奥深く行くわけじゃないので\n最初は浅いエリアで腕試し的に初:
That said, you won't be going deep right from the start,
so begin by testing yourself in the shallow areas♪
strings.メイズ内は特殊な環境なのでマスターの指揮が\nとても重要だってこと忘れないでくだ:
The Maze is a special environment, so please don't forget that the Master's command
is extremely important!!
strings.先程生徒会長からも言われたとおり、\nメイズでは生徒達のレベルは指揮官ランクによ:
As the Student Council President said earlier,
inside the Maze the students' levels are limited by your Commander Rank!
strings.深淵を切り開くのは貴方たちの意思です。各機、潜航を開始せよ！: It is your will that carves open the abyss. All units, begin your dive!
strings.最後に！大事な事をお伝えします！: Lastly! I have something important to tell you!
strings.エリアを進めるにつれ報酬も豪華になるので、\nより奥のエリアを目指して探索してい:
Rewards get more lavish as you advance through areas,
so keep exploring and aim for deeper areas!
strings.そうそう！明日から最高到達エリアによって\n毎日メイズ探索にくる事でデイリー報酬:
Oh, right! Starting tomorrow, the Student Council will hand out daily rewards
based on the deepest area you've reached, just for visiting Maze Exploration every day♪
strings.タツミヤ鉱と引き換えに<color=#ff1c0b>生徒のスキル強化アイテムを獲: By trading Tatsumiya Ore you can <color=#ff1c0b>obtain items that enhance student skills</color> or <color=#ff1c0b>upgrade MG parts</color>, pushing your stats even higher!
strings.一定深度まで進行したらタツミヤ鉱を回収して戻って来てくださいね？\n長時間メイズ:
Once you've reached a certain depth, collect your Tatsumiya Ore and come back, all right?
Staying inside the Maze for a long time is dangerous!!
strings.道中レリックを見つけたら超高性能ＡＩがレリックの効果を特定します！\n色んな効果:
When you find a Relic along the way, the super-high-performance AI identifies its effect!
There are all kinds of effects, so choose ones that give you an edge as you advance!
strings.メイズ内はまだまだ解明されていない事も多く、\n謎アイテムその１！メイズ内だけで:
There is still so much unsolved inside the Maze,
so here's mystery item number one! A Relic that shows its true worth only inside the Maze!!
strings.探索中にメイズシフターとの戦闘がありますが、\n無事掃討する事が出来れば<col:
You'll battle Maze Shifters while exploring,
and if you wipe them out safely you can obtain <color=#b500f8>Tatsumiya Ore</color>!!
strings.広大なメイズ内はまだまだ未開拓のエリアが沢山存在します！\nそれゆえ、毎回同じル:
The vast Maze still holds plenty of unexplored areas!
That's why the route is never the same twice!!
strings.ピコーン！ここはピコが説明します！\nいえ、ピコに説明させて下さい！！！！:
Ding! This is where Pico explains!
No, please let Pico do the explaining!!!!
strings.ピコーン！グッと成長しましたね！\n一皮むけた仲間を連れてクエストに出撃しましょ:
Ding! She grew a whole lot!
Take your newly polished comrade out on a quest♪
strings.限界突破するとレアリティがアップし、ステータスがアップします！\nレベル上限も4:
A Limit Break raises rarity and stats!
It also raises the level cap by 4 tiers, so when growth feels capped, go for a Limit Break!
strings.以下のアイテムを使用して限界突破を実行します: The Limit Break will be performed using the items below
strings.生徒達がもう一段階強くなるためには限界突破が必要です！\nさっそく限界突破させて:
To make the students one step stronger, a Limit Break is required!
Let's try a Limit Break right away!
strings.限界突破には「スタイルカード」を使用します。\nスタイルカードは、既に所持してい:
Limit Breaks use “Style Cards”.
You can get Style Cards by obtaining students you already own from the gacha and elsewhere!
strings.もしかしてまだ限界突破を行ってないですか！？: Could it be that you still haven't done a Limit Break!?
strings.待ち合わせは、待ち合わせした生徒が次の日に必ずエリアにやってくるようになります！:
Meet-Ups make the student you booked show up in the area the very next day!
You can book Meet-Ups with up to 3 students!
strings.どうしても会いたい生徒がいるときは、待ち合わせを活用しましょう！: When there's a student you absolutely want to meet, make use of Meet-Ups!
strings.<line-height=2.000em>指揮官にまつわる各種ランキングを確認す: <line-height=2.000em>You can check the various rankings related to commanders.\nWhen someone reaches a certain threshold, rewards are handed out to everyone.
strings.一条白奈「期待応える輝きの穹」 <size=30><color=#6a8181>: Ichijo Shirona “Radiance That Lives Up to Expectations” <size=30><color=#6a8181>@Shirona_I</color>
strings.当然，实际见到之前还是不好说啦。: Of course, we won't know until we actually see it.
strings.……嗯，肯定没问题的。: ...Yeah. I'm sure it will be fine.
strings.应该没必要变得那么悲观吧？ 光看社交平台的反应，似乎也没造成多大的损害，况且骚动: I don't think we need to be so pessimistic, do we? Going by what I see on SNS, it doesn't look like much damage was done, and the uproar was centered on the academy.
strings.我一定会相信的，一定会没事的……: I want to believe that it will be all right...
strings.＠Rami_K\\n……确实，关于学园之外的事情我们还没来得及确认，就这么直接开: ＠Rami_K\n...True. We still haven't confirmed anything about the world outside the academy, and here we are already setting off for Serenosia Island.
strings.桃園める「蒼き穹舞うフラットスピン」 <size=30><color=#6a81: Momozono Meru “Flat Spin Dancing in the Azure Sky” <size=30><color=#6a8181>@Meru_M</color><space=1.5em>Momozono Meru “Flat Spin Dancing in the Azure Sky” <size=30><color=#6a8181>@Meru_M</color>
strings.唉……糟糕……总觉得事到如今才开始坐立不安了……: Haah... This is bad... I think I'm only just now starting to get antsy...
strings.我听说临时据点是用帐篷搭建的……没想到比想象中要正式嘛。: I heard the temporary base would be tents... but it's far more put together than I expected.
strings.不过话说回来……学园里有名的队伍都聚在一起，还真是壮观啊。: Still, having every famous team in the academy gathered in one place is quite a sight.
strings.……虽然现在可能不是说这个的时候，不过天都她没事吧？: ...This might not be the right moment for it, but I wonder if Amatsu is all right?
strings.＠T_Commander\\n那么，重新介绍一下，我是Colorful Bouq: ＠T_Commander\nWell then, allow me to introduce myself again. I'm Ikoma Aoi of Colorful Bouquet.\nI'll be counting on you.
